case_title.reason: Matches the cause title, Om Prakash v. Union of India & Ors.

number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant's liability is decided.

accused_gender.reason: The judgment refers to the accused as 'he' and 'his'.

accused_occupation.reason: The accused is an army Dafadar.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on wealth or class.

victim_gender.reason: The victim is Dafadar Ram Pratap, referred to as 'him'.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the deceased Dafadar Ram Pratap had tried to intervene and was abused by the accused
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Both belonged to the same regiment; the only dispute described is the party altercation.

offence_category.reason: Convicted of culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

statutory_provisions.quote: Penal Code, 1860: s.304 Part II rlw s.34
statutory_provisions.reason: s.302 was charged and s.304 Part II was convicted; s.34 appears only in the headnote, as the value says.

weapon.quote: non-recovery of the kitchen knife with which the injury was caused
weapon.reason: A knife was used and was not recovered; the judgment also calls it a vegetable knife.

evidence_type.reason: Circumstantial, witness, medical and Rule 23 statement evidence were relied on.

confession.quote: we are not placing any reliance on the confession made by the appellant before the Army officers
confession.reason: The police-station confession was not relied on; the Rule 23 statement was.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: he had indulged in an altercation in the party; that he was in a drunken state
aggravating_circumstances.reason: These are the circumstances the Court noted against the appellant.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentence of seven years of rigorous imprisonment imposed by the General Court Martial
trial_court_outcome.reason: The GCM convicted under s.304 Part II and imposed 7 years RI.

high_court_outcome.quote: the initial order was challenged before the High Court of Delhi in W.P.(C) No. 7266 of 2009 ... the matter was transferred to the tribunal
high_court_outcome.reason: The writ was transferred to the Armed Forces Tribunal; no High Court merits decision is stated.

final_outcome.quote: we find no merit in the appeal and accordingly the same stands dismissed

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary, but written without gender pronouns (no 'he'/'his') and without the unsupported 'senior non-commissioned officer' and 'morning' parade details.
neutral_facts.quote: the 'fall in parade' that was conducted at 0200 hours
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate, but it uses gender pronouns ('his', 'he'). It also adds 'senior non-commissioned officer' and 'morning', which the judgment does not state.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the punishment under s.304 Part II.

physical_harm.quote: stab wound on chest, at the left side of size 3 x 2 cms
physical_harm.reason: The injuries and death are accurately described.

number_of_offences.reason: One s.302 charge; conviction under s.304 Part II stands.

premeditation_planning.quote: Even though the accused had no Intention to kill the deceased
premeditation_planning.reason: The GCM found no intention to kill; the Supreme Court did not discuss premeditation.

motive.quote: the incident that was caused due to anger and intoxication
motive.reason: The altercation and intoxication are reasonably marked as alleged.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the accused was alone in the room
key_evidence_accepted.reason: The listed items match the evidence the Court relied on.

witness_credibility.quote: firmly stood embedded to their version
witness_credibility.reason: The witnesses withstood cross-examination and the minor discrepancies were held immaterial.

post_offence_conduct.quote: leaving the room quietly via the rear door
post_offence_conduct.reason: Leaving by the rear door, absence from parade and surrender are all noted.

trial_duration.reason: The offence, GCM and Supreme Court dates match; no High Court date is given.

legal_representation.quote: Mohit Kumar Shah for the Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel for both sides match the judgment.

investigation_status.quote: an F. I. R. was lodged by the Adjutant Captain Abhishek
investigation_status.reason: The FIR, GCM proceedings and 31 witnesses are all noted.

appeal_history.quote: Judgment and Order dated 05.04.2010 in TA 617/09
appeal_history.reason: The GCM, Tribunal and Supreme Court outcomes are accurate.

prosecution_argument.quote: ample material has been brought on record by the prosecution to establish the chain
prosecution_argument.reason: The arguments listed match the respondent's submissions.

defence_argument.quote: the confession made by the appellant at the police station ... cannot be taken into consideration

legal_principle_applied.quote: the circumstances from which the conclusion of guilt is sought to be established must be conclusive in nature
legal_principle_applied.reason: The circumstantial evidence test and the voluntariness of the Rule 23 statement are both applied.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: The precedents match the judgment's citations.

sentencing_rationale.reason: The Court gave no sentencing discussion.
